notes: Stdlib-only core: a seeded logic grid (one cat, or 2 or 3, per row, column and region; no two touching) whose every board has one answer. Writes only its own three SOIL collections, through libs/storage-backend, inputs-only so a record replays. catgrid/web/engine.js is a port held to the Python by tests/test_differential.py (308 boards cell for cell, 9,000 moves, the daily round); Python is the anchor, and the catgrid-differential CI job asserts the comparison ran rather than skipped. Trivia reads Jeles's corpus beside the repo and never ships it in the page; napkin words are Gerald's, in this repo. The daily board's drand BLS signature is not checked. Plays on the-table as catgrid, catgrid_2cat, catgrid_3cat and catgrid_duel, and as a puzzle beat in a story.
